description: Self-test config for the audit infrastructure. The subject is the Lead's WinUI 3 toolchain smoke app (.probe/winui3-smoke), which renders ONE page, so both entries point at the same view with different navigation steps. This validates the whole chain: launch once per theme, reuse the process across pages, multi-step capture, Light/Dark system theme override, PNG + UIA evidence, criteria evaluation. It is NOT a per-page audit of the real product.
